program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((clean-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                        (let ((v (at g r 0)))
                                          (and
                                            (!= v 0)
                                            (all? (lambda (kc) (= (at g r kc) v))
                                                  (range 1 w)))))
                                      (range 0 h)))
                  (clean (and (> (length clean-rows) 0) (at g (first clean-rows) 0))))
             (if clean
                 (list (list clean))
                 (let* ((dirty-row (find-first (lambda (r)
                                                 (let ((v (at g r 0)))
                                                   (and
                                                     (!= v 0)
                                                     (> (for/sum ((kc (range 0 w)))
                                                          (if (= (at g r kc) v) 1 0))
                                                        (- w 2)))))
                                               (range 0 h)))
                        (dr dirty-row)
                        (major (at g dr 0))
                        (anom (find-first (lambda (v) (!= v major))
                                          (map (lambda (kc) (at g dr kc)) (range 0 w)))))
                   (list (list anom))))))))
